[[Law and Order]] are [[unique item|unique]] [[daggers]] dropped by [[Silent Peacekeeper]]s and [[White Mantle Enforcer]]s in [[Kryta]] during the [[War in Kryta]].

==Stats==
:[[Cold damage]]: 7-17 (Requires 9 [[Dagger Mastery]])
:[[Damage]] +15% (while [[Enchantment|Enchanted]])
:[[Enchantment]]s last 20% longer

==Skin==
This item has the same appearance as two [[Canthan Shortsword]]s.
